message.reasoning_content: Key risk: candidates lie on a sphere of radius ~1 around query in 32-D — distances are all ~1, and quantization to 1/8 grid may make winner differ from reference winner. The 0.1 relative tolerance: embeddings are N(0,1) 8-D, norm ~2.8; picking the wrong embedding gives relative error ~sqrt(2) ≈ 1.4 >> 0.1. So it comes down to whether the quantized route picks the same index. Run the probe.
